opportunities.title: Propose vulnerability identity key and lifecycle schema
opportunities.summary: ### Summary Inspect the committed Anchore JSON fixtures and propose a schema for tracking vulnerabilities over time. Specifically: what combination of fields uniquely identifies "the same vulnerability" across scans? Candidates to evaluate include CVE ID alone, CVE + package name, CVE + package name + version, and CVE + package + image. Write up the tradeoffs, pick a recommendation, and sketch the analytics DB table(s) needed to support first_seen / last_seen / fixed_at / ignored_at / cleared_at fields. **Tech notes:** The Anchore JSON schema is documented at the Anchore project site; worth skimming before diving into fixtures. The goal of this spike is a decision, not code — resist the urge to start implementing. ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] Written proposal (markdown doc in PR) covering identity key options, tradeoffs, and a recommendation - [ ] Proposed analytics DB schema with column types and rationale - [ ] At least one worked example from the fixtures showing how the identity key behaves across days - [ ] Reviewed and approved by Brandon and/or Matt before next ticket starts ## Bounty: $250 This issue has been selected for our paid contributor program. If you wish to claim

opportunities.title: Automate Bug Detection and Reviews
opportunities.summary: Automate Low Hanging fruit bug detection and issue creation recursively. This issue is an issue focused on creating more issues: 1. Find a feature/bug to work on from this repository 2. Create a GitHub issue on the repository to start working on it -- Pull requests without issues will not be considered. 3. Use the following string in the issue that you created: "This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. If you would like to work on it, please create another issue with the same contents and refer to issue #11398 for more information." Follow all instructions carefully and precisely. /bounty $800 Bounties can only be paid upon successful PR merge.

opportunities.title: [Bounty: $95] Add property-based tests for memory store append/list invariants
opportunities.summary: ## Context `InMemoryMemoryStore.listByAgent` filters entries by `agentId`. Deterministic loop tests do not prove ordering and filter invariants hold for arbitrary append sequences. ## Proposed Change Add a property-style test (via a dependency like `fast-check`, or a randomized loop) that appends many entries across agents and verifies `listByAgent` returns exactly those entries for each agent in append order. ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] Randomized append sequences covered - [ ] Append-order invariant asserted - [ ] Per-agent filter correctness asserted ## Suggested Label tests
